title: Latency panorama: cohorted p50/p95/p99 by model, route, and IO-mode
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Build an interactive "Latency Panorama" board that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency by model and route, with explicit IO-mode breakdown (streaming vs non-streaming), request-shape cohorting, and trace links to Tempo. This board will be used by SRE, infra, and product to quickly localize regressions and validate rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for each model x route tile for last 1h/6h/24h. 2) Each tile can toggle streaming/non-streaming split and overlay request-shape cohort (short/medium/long). 3) Clicking a tile opens a trace search prefiltered by model, route, io_mode and percentile bucket. 4) Panels driven by metrics with stable names and tags; no expensive ad-hoc queries. 5) Alerting panel surfaced for p99 increases >25% vs baseline.
work_log: 2025-11-03 Triage: scoped with SRE and Console PM. 2025-11-06 Spike: assembled test dashboard using synthetic traffic in staging (dashboard prototype: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/TELEMETRY/Latency+Panorama+Prototype). 2025-11-11 Instrumentation PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4897 (adds redwood.request_latency_ms histograms with tag set {model,route,io_mode,request_shape}). 2025-11-14 Backend: metrics rename discussion with Observability team concluded; agreed to use histogram + summary bucket approach. 2025-11-18 Dashboard PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3124. 2025-11-20 QA: ran validation across 3 staging clusters; streaming split requires minor backend label fixes.
decisions: 1) Use latency histograms (prometheus-style buckets) for pN extraction to avoid heavy query aggregation. 2) Tagging schema: model (name@sha), route (string), io_mode (stream|sync), request_shape (short|mid|long). 3) Trace linkage will use trace_id exported as log field and saved in metrics sampled logs; Tempo will be the canonical trace store. 4) We will not attempt real-time percentiles at sub-second latency windows; 1s scrape + 10s window is acceptable trade-off.
